learning_objective.text_en: Recognise numbers as positions on a number line and be able to order values, add/subtract positive and negative integer numbers and be able to use real-life situations to understand positive and negative numbers.
learning_objective.text_zh: 将数字识别为数轴上的位置，并能够根据数值大小排序，加/减正负整数，并能够使用实际情况理解正负数。
